value.produces: rhapsody-golden.qcow2 (Rhapsody 5.1 DR2 x86 on a 2 GB IDE disk, /opt/qemu-rhapsody) + golden

value.kbd_note: Workspace Manager desktop; labctl exec gives a root shell over serial. Type into TextEdit/Terminal via labctl keys — unverified via UI
value.note: PS/2 relative pointer (dbus-rel), Mouse-Speed pref at slowest = dead-linear 0.478 px/unit -> cursor_scale 2.09; the daemon caps each PS/2 send at one packet (SH_REL_MAX_STEP) so a fast drag can't desync the guest. 1024x768 RGB:555/16 on Cirrus GD5446. Station QEMU /opt/qemu-rhapsody (i8259 lenient-cascade).

labctl.notes: labctl exec over a getty on COM1 (serial.sock; exec_kind serial_getty, user root, password in the gitignored <dir>/serial-exec.passwd). No network exec. PS/2 deltas mis-decode if the i8042 queue is flooded — the daemon paces; SH_REL_MAX_STEP caps each send at one packet. loadvm golden.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# rhapsody (slot 146) — Rhapsody 5.1 Developer Release 2 for Intel (Apple, 1998):
#   the Platinum Finder on the NeXT/Mach substrate. qemu-system-i386 from
#   /opt/qemu-rhapsody (kernel-hive fork + i8259 lenient-cascade patch, without
#   which the Mach kernel loses every IDE interrupt). TCG, pentium2, 64 MB, one
#   2 GB IDE disk, Cirrus GD5446 at 800x600x16, i82557b, PS/2 mouse (dbus-rel).
#   loadvm golden -S (the daemon resumes). DARK LAUNCH: listing=hidden until the
#   operator eyeballs it.
render.bindingComment: NeXTSTEP -> Rhapsody -> Mac OS X lineage

museum.lineage: Apple Rhapsody (NeXTSTEP/Mach → Mac OS X Server 1.0)
museum.blurb: Apple's Mac OS 8 face grafted onto the NeXT operating system it had just bought — the 1998 developer release where Mac OS X begins.
museum.notes: Intel build under TCG on a station-specific QEMU (/opt/qemu-rhapsody, i8259 lenient-cascade patch). Sits between the nextstep station and the macos poster. Dark-launched; hidden until the operator eyeballs it.

notes: labctl exec via serial getty on COM1 (serial_getty); credentials in gitignored serial-exec.passwd
